# ===== VEHICLE MODULE - Login =====
Navigate to the forcefieldshare login page

Enter password in Login Form
Click on Sign In button
Wait for the login to complete before navigating
# ===== Section 1: Vehicle - Add / Edit / Notes / Incident / Delete =====
Navigate directly to the Vehicle List page
Wait for the Vehicle List page to load before checking the Add button
Wait for Vehicle List page to load
Click on Add New Vehicle button
Wait for the add vehicle form to open
Enter the vehicle name in the Name field
Enter the registration number in the Registration Number field
Select HYUNDAI from the Make dropdown
Wait for the Model dropdown to load for the selected make
Select ACCENT from the Model dropdown
Wait for the Year dropdown to appear after selecting the model
Select 2007 from the Year dropdown - required field shown after Model
Select C - Car from the License Class dropdown
Select Branch_1 from the Branch dropdown
Select Automatic from the Transmission dropdown
Select 4 Wheel Drive from the Body Type dropdown
Click the Save button to create the vehicle
Wait for the vehicle save to complete
Reload the Vehicle List page so the add form is fully closed
Wait for the Vehicle List page to load after reload
Wait for the vehicle search box
Search for the created vehicle in the vehicle list
Wait for the vehicle search results to load
Verify the created vehicle appears in the search results
Click the edit pencil icon on the created vehicle row
Wait for the edit vehicle form to open
Enter VIN in edit form
Click the Save button to save the vehicle edit
Wait for the vehicle edit save to complete
Click the notes icon on the created vehicle row
Wait for the notes panel to open
Select Info from the Type of Note dropdown
Enter the note text in the note box
Click the Add Note button
Wait for the note to be added
Verify the added note text is shown in the notes panel
Click the close cross of the notes panel
Wait for the notes panel to close
Click the raise incident alert icon on the created vehicle row
Wait for the incident form to open
Select Break from the Type of incident dropdown
Select Yes from the Critical dropdown
Enter the date of incident in the Date of Incident field
Select Date of Incident 10 Oct 2026
Enter India in the incident location search
Wait for the address suggestions to load
Click the first India address suggestion in the incident location list
Select Reporter Yash Poniya (System Manager)
Click the Save button to raise the incident
Wait for the incident save to complete
Reload the Vehicle List page before removing the test vehicle
Wait for the Vehicle List page to load after reload
Wait for the vehicle search box before removal
Search for the created vehicle again before removal
Wait for the search results before removal
Click the bin icon on the created vehicle row only
Click the Yes button to confirm removal
